summary: Iteration 3: Parts Kits. Backend 8/8 pytest passing (tests/test_parts_kits.py). The seeded 'URLinc Gold' kit has material gold and all 20 slots, and its PNGs are served by /api/files. /slots returns the slot list. Create kit works (an empty name gives 422). Upload works; unknown slot -> 400; non-image -> 400; missing kit -> 404. Part removal works. Soft delete removes the kit from the list, clears parts_kit_id on tables that used it, and a second delete -> 404. PUT table with a kit id sets it, '' clears it to null, a bogus id -> 404. Generate with parts_kit_id sets parts_kit_id and style.material='gold' (1 table, deleted afterwards). Generate with an unknown kit -> 404. Frontend, all passing with no console errors: /brand shows the gold kit with 20/20 slot thumbnails loaded; create-kit-btn creates a kit and delete-kit confirm removes it. Editor Brand tab: editor-parts-kit-select switches between gold and drawn parts, the preview canvas re-renders (gold caps/flippers/aprons/targets vs drawn), the unsaved indicator shows, and both clearing and setting the kit survive Save + reload. Home: forge-parts-kit-select lists 'Drawn parts (no kit)' and 'URLinc Gold'. Play da0fe73f: the kit is rendered, story skip works, the plunger launched and flippers were pressed, score reached 13,250 with no errors. Regression: the story crawl closed by itself after about 45s.
critical_code_review_comments: parts.py upload_part accepts any image/* type, including image/svg+xml, and takes the extension from the client filename. Restrict uploads to png/webp/jpeg to avoid SVG script injection when files are served inline.
upload_part reads the whole file into memory before checking the 8MB limit. Minor.

PartsKits.jsx: the remove-kit and remove-part handlers have no try/catch or error toast. useTableImages has no catch around the async IIFE, so a failed /parts-kits fetch is an unhandled rejection and the images never load.
delete_kit soft-deletes the kit but leaves its db.files records undeleted (the art delete path does mark them deleted). Inconsistent with that path.
KitUpdate allows any material value and drops invalid ones silently instead of returning 422.
seed_data_creation: TEST_kit and TEST_UI Kit kits were created and soft-deleted (2 of the TEST_UI Kit, one from a crashed script run). One TEST_ generated table was deleted. Table da0fe73f is back on the URLinc Gold kit (04cf03a3-7166-43ec-81e3-492cbf837a77).
